messages:
hazel-people-ops: Quick note 4DD We pushed two small handbook edits for Open Enrollment exceptions and special enrollment windows (contractor conversions, late hires). Please review and complete the short manager acknowledgement by EOD Fri. Handbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HR/pages/Open+Enrollment+Exceptions

omar-benefits: TL;dr on changes for payroll: we added a new enroll_code field and extended the enrollment window for documented life events to 60 days. Payroll, please accept enroll_code EXCEP and prorate deductions accordingly.

lucy-legal: Added mandatory language about proof requirements and data minimization for late enrollments. For UK/DE we added reference to local statutory windows; no auto-enroll for those geos until local counsel signs off. Diff is on Confluence.

ben-hiringops: Manager question: if a candidate signs after offer acceptance and before start date, do we treat them as "late hire" or "new hire" for benefits enrollment? I have two offers in that window.

hazel-people-ops: Good Q. Rule: if start_date <= payroll_close_date for month of hire, treat as new hire; else late hire with EXCEP code. Added a decision tree to the manager checklist.

tara-emea: EMEA note: hold off on applying EXCEP for DE/FR until I confirm localized wording. I'll post a list of teams affected by noon tomorrow.

omar-benefits: Payroll sample CSV for the EXCEP feed (please use enroll_code EXCEP):
```
employee_id,start_date,enroll_code,plan_code,prorate_pct
77701,2026-09-18,EXCEP,MED-1,50
```

hazel-people-ops: Managers: please fill the exceptions sheet and attach required documentation in the tracker. Small microlearning assigned to managers and benefits admins. Acks due next Wed. Link: https://training.redwood.com/assignments/open-enroll-excep

ack-bot: Assigned "Open Enrollment Exceptions: Manager Acknowledgement" to affected managers. Due: 2026-09-30. Tracking: https://training.redwood.com/assignments/oe-excep-2026

lucy-legal: One more legal request: add an appeals flow for disputed denials and a 30-day retention policy for submitted docs. I'll upload language this afternoon.

hazel-people-ops: Thanks all 44D I'll compile a digest and post the rollout checklist in #people-ops. Ping me directly if you own a region or need an API for bulk uploads.
